title: Add slugify
prompt: Add a function slugify(text) in app/text.py that lowercases the text, replaces every run of non-alphanumeric characters with one '-' and strips leading/trailing '-'. Add tests.
check: from app.text import slugify; assert slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'; assert slugify('  A  b ') == 'a-b'

title: Add fizzbuzz
prompt: Add fizzbuzz(n) in app/fizz.py returning the list of strings for 1..n (Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for 5, FizzBuzz for both, else the number as a string). Add tests.
check: from app.fizz import fizzbuzz; r = fizzbuzz(15); assert r[2] == 'Fizz' and r[4] == 'Buzz' and r[14] == 'FizzBuzz' and r[0] == '1' and len(r) == 15

title: Fix average of empty list
prompt: Bug: app/stats.py average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError. It must return 0.0 for an empty list. Fix it and add a regression test.
check: from app.stats import average; assert average([]) == 0.0; assert average([2, 4]) == 3

title: Add word counter
prompt: Add count_words(text) in app/words.py returning a dict of lowercase word -> count (words are split on whitespace, punctuation .,;:!? is stripped). Add tests.
check: from app.words import count_words; assert count_words('The the. cat!') == {'the': 2, 'cat': 1}

title: Refactor greeting
prompt: Refactor: move the greeting text of app/main.py into a new function greeting(name='world') in app/greet.py that returns 'Hello, <name>!'. app/main.py keeps its health() function. Add tests.
check: from app.greet import greeting; assert greeting() == 'Hello, world!'; assert greeting('Ada') == 'Hello, Ada!'; from app.main import health; assert health() == 'ok'

title: Add a stack class
prompt: Add class Stack in app/stack.py with push(x), pop() (raises IndexError when empty), peek() and __len__. Add tests including the empty case.
